user.title: Connect to Trade Republic
user.description: Choose your authentication method. Using the Trade Republic Home Assistant App is recommended to automatically solve bot challenges and keep sessions alive 24/7 without manual tokens.

manual.title: Manual Credentials / Token
manual.description: Enter your phone number and PIN or a manual session token copied from your browser.

addon.title: Trade Republic App
addon.description: Connect via Trade Republic Home Assistant App to keep sessions alive automatically. Please ensure the Trade Republic App add-on is installed, running and accessible (default container host: 605cee21_traderepublic / 127.0.0.1, port 8095).

addon_confirm.title: Trade Republic App Found
addon_confirm.description: An active Trade Republic Home Assistant App was found ({host}). Would you like to connect to it to automatically manage your session?

addon_scan.title: Log in with QR Code (Trade Republic)
addon_scan.description:
Please scan the QR code below using your Trade Republic mobile app (Profile → Settings → Web Login / Scan QR).

![QR Code]({qr_image})

**Please click Submit after confirming in the app.**

data.use_phone_login: Log in with Phone Number & PIN instead

addon_login.title: Login via Trade Republic App
addon_login.description: Enter your credentials. The Trade Republic App handles authentication and keeps the session active.

addon_2fa.title: Confirm Login in Trade Republic App
addon_2fa.description: A login request has been sent to your Trade Republic smartphone app. Please open the app and approve the login prompt, or enter the 4-digit push code if you received one.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Please enter the verification code sent to your phone or app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Trade Republic
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. If using the App, simply sync or log in again via Home Assistant. If using Manual Mode, enter a fresh session token or PIN.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Trade Republic servers.
error.cannot_connect_addon: Could not connect to the Trade Republic Add-on. Please ensure the Add-on is started and host/port are reachable (default: 605cee21_traderepublic:8095).
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your phone number and PIN.
error.invalid_pin: PIN must be between 4 and 6 digits (numbers only)
error.invalid_phone: Please provide a valid international phone number (e.g. +491701234567)
error.addon_no_session: No active session found in the Trade Republic Add-on. Please open the Add-on Web UI and log in first.
error.addon_api_error: Trade Republic rejected the login request (MISSING_REQUIRED_HEADER or WAF token error). This is an Add-on issue — please check Add-on logs, restart the Add-on, or wait for an Add-on update.
error.addon_api_outdated: Trade Republic has disabled the v1 login API (returned 426 CLIENT_VERSION_OUTDATED). The Add-on must be updated to support the current v2 push-approval login. Please update the Trade Republic Add-on.
error.timeout_expired: The login challenge timed out (2 minutes exceeded). Click Submit to send a new login request to your Trade Republic app.
error.approval_pending: Login not yet confirmed. Please open your Trade Republic smartphone app and approve the login prompt, then click Submit again.
error.qr_not_confirmed: The QR code has not yet been approved in the Trade Republic app or has expired. Please re-scan the QR code and click Submit.

init.title: Trade Republic Options
init.description: Adjust update interval, interest rate, or trigger an instant re-authentication directly within Home Assistant.

reauth_required.title: Trade Republic Re-authentication Required
reauth_required.description: Your Trade Republic session has expired. Please re-authenticate your integration.
